endpoints.description: Returns API readiness plus dependency status (also mounted at /api/v1/health for client callers).

rest_exception.note: Plain GET /health for lifecycle systems, load balancers, and curl probes that cannot use a generated Connect client.

endpoints.summary: Count scenarios that failed measures validation in a window
endpoints.description: Answers "how many scenarios failed measures validation this week": a read-only, run-eligible, full-tier measure over the persisted validation_run history, parameterized by the canonical time_window. Backed by the same compute path as the /measures serve registry.

endpoints.summary: Count scenarios that passed measures validation in a window
endpoints.description: Answers "how many scenarios passed measures validation this week" — the fleet measure-coverage signal over time. Read-only, run-eligible, full-tier (canonical time_window). Backed by the same compute path as the /measures serve registry.

endpoints.summary: Match an analytical question to a measure and answer it
endpoints.description: The federated measures provider (search-hub 'measure' type): matches a natural-language analytical question to the best-fitting measure across the fleet, resolves its parameters (deterministic time_window first, constrained extraction for the rest), and — for a safe read-only measure resolved at high confidence — proxies execution to the owning scenario and returns the answer with provenance. A write/destructive measure is never auto-executed.

properties.limit: int (max measure hits; a measure provider returns the best answer)

examples.name: Answer an analytical question
examples.curl: curl http://localhost:${API_PORT}/vrooli.measures_health.v1.search.SearchService/Search -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"how many backlog items did we complete this week","limit":1}'

endpoints.description: Reports the central measure index size, whether the ollama constrained-extraction backend is reachable, and the active matcher leg — so callers (and the search-hub status_endpoint) can degrade gracefully.
Grades a scenario's measure adoption through the shared scenario-validation response; the native ScenarioCoverageReport is packed into native_detail.

properties.include_execution: bool (run the behavioral adoption probe against live endpoints)

endpoints.summary: Roll up measure coverage across scenarios
endpoints.description: Statically grades every discovered scenario (or the requested subset) and returns one coverage rollup each: expected/covered/waived/uncovered counts, worst tier, and the pass/fail verdict. Powers the fleet-view UI.
